repairs.quote: Yunara gains 30/35/40/45/50% Move Speed, increased to 45/52.5/60/67.5/75% Move Speed when moving toward an enemy champion, for 1.5 seconds. Transcendent State - Untouchable Shadow: Yunara dashes in a direction. Kanmei's Steps causes Yunara to become Ghosted. Untouchable Shadow gains the benefits of an Ultimate Ability.

limitations.detail: 이속1.5초는 명시되어 있으나 유체화 지속시간과궁극기효과의 구체내용은 공급본문에 없다.
